pagerduty-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert PD-12345 - high-severity: RateLimiterService - unexpected throttle spike detected. Triggered at 2026-03-14T03:12:11Z. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD-12345
incident-bot: New incident thread created by pagerduty-bot in #incidents. Auto-escalation to oncall. Paging SRE.
Maya: Acked. I'm oncall this rotation — will take lead. Looking at quick metrics now. :eyes:
Rupert (oncall): On call. I'm pulling the limiter dashboards and logs. Any immediate customer reports?
Leo (support): AcmeCorp (tenant acme-inc) raised a support ticket ~03:09 UTC: "sudden 429s for inference calls, high latency". Ticket ID 2026-ACME-711.
Josh: Heads up — I'm seeing a big 429 surge coming from quota-mapper path (service=quota-mapper, version=v2.3.4). Spike starts ~03:06-03:10 UTC. Single tenant appears mis-mapped to a tiny quota bucket.
Maya: Can you paste a small excerpt from the logs showing the mapping decision? Need to confirm it's a mapping bug vs upstream limiter.
Josh: Paste logs:
```
03:05:42 INFO quota-mapper v2.3.4 rollout=tenant-defaults apply change for env=prod
03:06:58 WARN tenant=acme-inc mapped_quota=small_pool reason=policy-default
03:07:05 ERROR limiter: deny request tenant=acme-inc code=429 token_bucket=exhausted
03:08:10 INFO tenant=acme-inc quota_override=null source=config
```
Josh: That looks like a config rollout touched the tenant-defaults flag that inadvertently mapped this tenant to small_pool.
Karen: Did we push any infra or config change around 03:05? I was looking at the release board and saw a config-only change landed in infraops at 03:04.
Josh: Confirmed: rollout id rollout-2026-0314-tenant-defaults applied at 03:05 via infra-cfg-service.
Maya: Mitigation options:
- rollback the quota-mapper config change (fast)
- apply a tenant-specific override to bypass mapping for acme-inc (fastest, surgical)
- if rollback fails, route acme-inc traffic to dedicated limiter path
I'll take rollback + override in parallel.
Maya: Doing override now.
```
# apply temporary quota override for acme-inc
infractl quota override --tenant acme-inc --limit 500000 --reason "emergency bypass - incident PD-12345"
```
incident-bot: Action logged: quota override command executed by Maya at 2026-03-14T03:14:02Z.
pagerduty-bot: PD-12345 acknowledged by Maya (SRE) at 2026-03-14T03:14:05Z. Next escalation suppressed for 10m.
Rupert (oncall): Rolling back rollout-2026-0314-tenant-defaults. Applying rollback manifest now.
```
kubectl -n infra apply -f s3://infra-manifests/rollbacks/quota-mapper-rollback-2026-03-14.yaml
```
Josh: Rollback applied; quota-mapper pods restarted (3/3 ready) at 03:16:40 UTC.
Maya: Observability update: 429 rate for acme-inc dropped from 27% -> 3% within 90s of override. Now down to 0.7% after rollback.
Leo (support): AcmeCorp updated in ticket: they see successful requests resuming, "thanks, looks back to normal".
Karen: Good. Customer impact window estimate: 03:06 - 03:15 UTC (~9 minutes). We should notify account team and ops.
Maya: Temporary mitigation held. I'll keep PD incident open until metrics stable for 30m. Next steps: create follow-up tasks: postmortem, add e2e test for tenant-defaults rollout, add guardrail to prevent defaulting a tenant into small_pool.
Josh: Root cause (prelim): config rollout 'tenant-defaults' had a missing migration that treats tenants without explicit quotas as falling back to small_pool. Rollout applied without a canary for high-risk mapping.
Karen: I'll schedule postmortem meeting and assign owners: Josh (root cause), Maya (mitigation/runbook update), Karen (customer comms), Leo (support summary).
incident-bot: PD-12345: status updated -> mitigated. Incident owner: Maya. Will auto-resolve after stability window.
Maya: Thanks team. Quick note for oncall runbook update: add a checklist to confirm mapping logic before applying tenant-defaults, and add monitoring alert for single-tenant throttle spikes (delta > 5% of baseline).
Rupert (oncall): Added a temporary alert on quota-mapper: single-tenant-throttle-spike -> page if >10% of total 5m window.
Maya: Closing handoff: handing back to SRE rotation for watch. I'll write a short blameless postmortem draft once PD resolves. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: PD-12345 auto-resolve scheduled at 2026-03-14T03:45:05Z unless new events occur.
pagerduty-bot: Incident PD-12345 - mitigation in place. Pager escalations suppressed. :information_source:
Maya: End of thread for now. I'll post the postmortem URL here when ready."
